blocks.text: The Zscaler Notification Framework provides a streamlined, more flexible end user notification experience for Zscaler Client Connector for Windows and macOS. It also supports additional notifications that aren't included in and can't be disabled in the default OS-based notification system.

The Zscaler Notification Framework overrides the OS-based notification system. For Zscaler Client Connector for macOS versions 5.0 and earlier, Service Status and Private Access Reauthentication notifications are supported only by the OS, so even if the framework is enabled, you must also enable OS-based notifications to display these notifications.

When the framework is enabled, Zscaler notifications display in the bottom right corner of the screen. Up to 5 notifications can appear and time out after 5 seconds. You can move and dismiss these notifications by clicking anywhere on the window. You can also view these notifications in the Zscaler Client Connector Notifications window.
This notification framework limits duplicate messages. Duplicate messages that display within a 2-minute interval are suppressed.

blocks.item: To enable the Zscaler Notification Framework on Windows devices:
From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Windows.
On the App Profiles tab, click Add Windows Policy. The Add Windows Policy window appears.
In the Add Windows Policy window, enable Use Zscaler Notification Framework.
To enable the Zscaler Notification Framework on macOS devices:
Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later for macOS uses the Zscaler Notification Framework regardless of this setting.
From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > macOS.
On the App Profiles tab, click Add macOS Policy. The Add macOS Policy window appears.
In the Add macOS Policy window, enable Use Zscaler Notification Framework.
